description.en: Cross-platform GUI file manager inspired by Windows Explorer, built in C with raylib/raygui and 4 core ADTs (tree, stack, queue, linked list).
description.id: File manager GUI lintas OS terinspirasi Windows Explorer, dibangun dengan C, raylib/raygui, dan 4 ADT utama (tree, stack, queue, linked list).

impact.en: Shipped a desktop file manager for 3 OSes with 10+ keyboard shortcuts, undo/redo, trash recovery, and bulk-operation progress feedback.
impact.id: Merilis file manager desktop untuk 3 OS dengan 10+ shortcut keyboard, undo/redo, trash recovery, dan progress feedback untuk operasi massal.

highlights.en: Non-binary tree powers directory hierarchy and sidebar navigation.
highlights.id: Non-binary tree menggerakkan hierarki direktori dan navigasi sidebar.

highlights.en: Stack-based undo/redo across create, delete, rename, and paste actions.
highlights.id: Undo/redo berbasis stack untuk create, delete, rename, dan paste.

highlights.en: Queue-based clipboard workflow with progress UI for 10+ items.
highlights.id: Alur clipboard berbasis queue dengan UI progress untuk 10+ item.

highlights.en: Custom window chrome with resizable layout and modern toolbar.
highlights.id: Window chrome kustom dengan layout resizable dan toolbar modern.

highlights.en: Cross-platform build flow with bundled raylib and system fallback.
highlights.id: Build lintas OS dengan raylib bundling dan fallback ke sistem.
